findings: SDK tool_execution_start precedes tool_call; it is preparation, not proof of side effects.
An early tool_call approval alone can be invalidated by later argument mutation.
The tested host execution guard checks the final immutable snapshot and reuses that exact snapshot for execution.
limitations: This is the M0 spike, not the production permission service or UI.
The guard requires all active built-in/custom/MCP definitions to pass through host wrapping.
Arbitrary extension filesystem/process code outside the tool pipeline requires the later OS sandbox.
Model responses and approval decisions are synthetic local fixtures; SDK, file/command effects, MCP and IPC are real.
